params.prompt: Compose: the stone Tejaji shrine from the FIRST reference image (same shrine, same horseman-and-cobra idol, same oil lamp) on the left of frame at dusk at a village fair in 1990 — the shrine has only a FEW red threads, the stone cleaner — and beside it, right of frame in profile facing the shrine, the MAN from the second reference and the WOMAN from the third reference: his bare wrist held out, she tying a red sacred thread onto it. He is 35, jet-black hair, thin strong build, simple white cotton kurta; she is 30, deep-blue cotton sari with pallu over her head, gold nathni, red bindi, glass bangles; a small girl of five holds the hem of her mother's sari, half-hiding, watching. Behind them: a 1990 village fair at DUSK under a clear warm evening sky — kerosene pressure lanterns glowing softly on stalls, a SMALL old iron ferris wheel silhouetted, men in dhotis and white kurtas. ABSOLUTELY NO fire, NO flames, NO smoke, NO burning anywhere — only gentle lantern light and dusk sky. Rendered as a 1990 COLOR FILM PRINT with a white photo-album border: heavy film grain, faded warm Kodachrome colors, soft focus edges, a photograph aged thirty years in an album. No text anywhere.
